summary: Nexera Technologies Ltd, an Israeli foreign private issuer listed on Nasdaq, filed a Form 6-K disclosing the November 4, 2026 issuance of a Seventh Convertible Promissory Note to an institutional holder. Principal is $1,900,000 sold for $1,710,000 cash (90% of par) under a June 26, 2025 securities purchase agreement with $85.5 million remaining availability. Terms include 4% interest (14% on default), 28-month maturity, ten monthly payments beginning after month eighteen, conversion at the lower of $0.2366 or 88% of 20-day VWAP (floor $0.04732), and a 4.99% beneficial ownership cap. A warrant for 8,030,432 shares at $0.2366, 5.5-year term, accompanied the note. This is ordinary financing, not a special situation; dilution and variable-price overhang are the watch items.
